summary.ko: 여러 고객의 확정 업무와 가용 시간을 비교해 과부하·우선순위·여유를 계산합니다.
summary.en: Balance approved retainer commitments against realistic capacity and identify overload early.

exclusions: Employee scheduling or high-impact personnel decisions

required_inputs.description: Approved recurring work, deadlines, estimated effort, and rollover rules
Available hours, non-client work, leave, and planning period

workflow.instruction: Normalize commitments by period and distinguish fixed obligations, optional backlog, and unapproved requests.
Account for coordination, review, revisions, and non-client work instead of allocating every hour to production.
Compare demand with capacity and highlight bottlenecks, expiry or rollover rules, and deadline collisions.
Propose a prioritized plan and explicit trade-offs; leave client reprioritization and additional commitments for approval.

deliverables.name: Capacity plan
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Shows period, client, committed work, effort, available capacity, and gaps

deliverables.name: Priority decisions
deliverables.acceptance_criteria: Explains overload risks and feasible options

limitations: Do not infer availability from calendar gaps alone.
Effort estimates and client response times remain uncertain.
permission_boundaries: Do not reschedule client commitments, change retainers, or promise additional hours.
Keep clients’ commercially sensitive terms separated in recipient-facing drafts.
